description: Source file defining factory functions for creating various message builders and decoders related to control and user plane compression in a radio system.

methods.name: create_ofh_control_plane_static_compression_message_builder
methods.description: Creates a static control plane message builder for compression.

methods.name: create_ofh_control_plane_dynamic_compression_message_builder
methods.description: Creates a dynamic control plane message builder for compression.

methods.name: create_static_compr_method_ofh_user_plane_packet_builder
methods.description: Creates a static user plane packet builder with logger and compressor.

methods.name: create_dynamic_compr_method_ofh_user_plane_packet_builder
methods.description: Creates a dynamic user plane packet builder with logger and compressor.

methods.name: create_static_compr_method_ofh_user_plane_packet_decoder
methods.description: Creates a static user plane packet decoder with various parameters including logger, scs, cp, ru_nof_prbs, sector_id, decompressor, and compression parameters.

methods.name: create_dynamic_compr_method_ofh_user_plane_packet_decoder
methods.description: Creates a dynamic user plane packet decoder with parameters including logger, scs, cp, ru_nof_prbs, sector_id, and decompressor.
